articles.title: Nebuly: $21 Million Series A Funding Led By Planven To Expand Enterprise AI Return On Investment Platform
articles.snippet:
Nebuly, an enterprise AI analytics company headquartered in New York and Turin, Italy, has raised $21 million in Series A funding led by Planven. The financing will support the expansion of its platform for measuring the financial and operational value of AI agents, along with additional sales and engineering investments across the United States and Europe. The round included participation from Exor Ventures, Tenacity Capital, TGVG Capital, and Fastweb+Vodafone through Founders Factory, alongside returning investors and angel investors.

articles.title: Griffin: $20 Million Series B Funding Led By Octagon Partners To Expand Card Issuing And Stablecoin Banking Services
articles.snippet:
Griffin, a United Kingdom-based licensed bank providing embedded banking infrastructure to fintech companies and technology platforms, has raised $20 million in Series B funding led by Octagon Partners. Notion Capital, A+ Ventures, Nordic Ninja, Breega, and other existing investors participated in the round, which values Griffin at more than $100 million.
The post Griffin: $20 Million Series B Funding Led By Octagon Partners To Expand Card Issuing And Stablecoin Banking Services appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .

articles.title: Biomatter: $18 Million Series A To Expand AI-Designed Enzyme Platform
articles.snippet:
Biomatter has raised $18 million in an oversubscribed Series A round to expand its artificial intelligence-powered enzyme design platform, commercial organization, and U.S. presence. Astanor led the financing, with participation from existing investors UVC Partners, Inventure, and Metaplanet.

articles.snippet:
